what: Why the Genesis portraits never showed on the user's phone, the fix, and the first distinct visuals of the signatures.

portrait_defect.user_report: On the phone no portrait appeared anywhere, even with portrait=200, and no visual difference between characters.
portrait_defect.server_log: The phone (192.168.1.155) loaded the page and the build three times between 09:22 and 09:25 and never requested /genesis-art/.
portrait_defect.reproduction: Headless Chrome on http://192.168.1.85:8083/?token=1795 (the LAN address) made no portrait request and logged 'Non-secure network connections disabled in Player Settings' and 'InvalidOperationException: Insecure connection not allowed'. The same page on http://127.0.0.1:8083 loaded the portraits.
portrait_defect.cause: PlayerSettings.insecureHttpOption was 0 (not allowed): UnityWebRequest refuses plain HTTP except to loopback, and throws from SendWebRequest, which ended the loading coroutine silently.
portrait_defect.fix: The qualification build sets PlayerSettings.insecureHttpOption to AlwaysAllowed; GenesisPortrait catches the refusal, retries failed downloads, shows a grey disc while an image is missing, and reports counters in the performance overlay.
portrait_defect.verified: Headless Chrome on the LAN address: six /genesis-art/ requests answered 200 and the overlay line read 'portraits shown 7 requests 6 loaded 6 failed 0 last error none, from http://192.168.1.85:8083/genesis-art/256/'.
portrait_defect.not_verified: The user's phone itself, after the fix.

signature_visuals.how: One generic attack prefab (QuantumUser/Resources/Genesis/GenesisAttack.prefab) whose view, GenesisAttackView, instantiates the effect named by the attack data and scales it; the effects come from the Cartoon FX pack bundled with the sample and from the sample's own VFX.

assigned.puddle: unchanged: the sample's lobbed projectile and arrow zone

seen: Nova: a large orange cartoon explosion centred on the hero, about the size of its area (genesis-signature-nova-headless-2026-10-09.png).

Flash: a ring with sparks in front of the hero, captured late in its life (genesis-signature-flash-headless-2026-10-09.png); its aim preview is a cone in front of the hero (genesis-signature-flash-aim-headless-2026-10-09.png).
signature_visuals.not_seen: Beam and wave visuals: the automated browser runs at about 5 frames per second and its emulated touch does not always fire, so neither was captured. Both fired and dealt their damage in the earlier log-based runs.
signature_visuals.defect_found_and_fixed: The first build with the generic prefab shipped without its entity prototype in the Quantum asset database; every signature then threw 'Could not find prototype asset'. The importer now checks the prototype's registration too. That broken build was live on the local server for about four minutes.

test_option: Page option charged=1 (for the player who creates the room): every character enters with its special charged. Verified: the charge ring is lit at spawn and bots fire signatures in the first seconds.
limits: Software rendering at about 5 frames per second: timing, brightness and feel are not representative.
Effects are not tinted by team, and the cone preview of the flash is longer than its real area.
Numbers are still placeholders; Aura and Tier change nothing yet.
